column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, same shape as catalogdiff-dialect-tests.tsv's sibling line in this same job/package -- unlike TestSnapshotIsIdenticalForTwoBuildsOfTheSameChainMSSQL (a standalone top-level function with no subtests), this test's mssqlDiffCase helper wraps each case in its own t.Run, so the parent reports PASS and each of the three subtests reports its own skip. PostgreSQL runs the rest of the job, MSSQL is absent here, all three subtests skip -- three, not one. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./migration/catalogdiff/... -run TestTheMSSQLSnapshotSeesTheAttributesItSelects -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these three, 0 failures.

Same test, same per-subtest shape, this job's own dialect: this job runs the full unfiltered ./engine/... ./migration/... sweep with ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, so MSSQL is absent here too and all three subtests skip. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL=<my> go test ./migration/... -run TestTheMSSQLSnapshotSeesTheAttributesItSelects -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these three, 0 failures. A full ./migration/... run (26 skips on unmodified develop, 29 with this test added) confirms the delta is exactly these three and nothing else moved.
